title: Request a Program
description: Programs are available for free to any UW–Madison student or student group.

blocks.title: Request a Program
blocks.lead: Free for any UW–Madison student or student group.
body: Bring a workshop, a peer support group or a volunteer training to your organization, class, residence hall or team. Choose a program, tell us about your group, and we will follow up to plan it.

steps.text: Pick one of the four below. Each section says who it suits and what it covers.
One short form: workshops use the workshop request; groups and trainings use the program request.
The team contacts you to plan the details. A request is not a confirmed booking.

items.title: Wellness Workshops
lines: Interactive sessions, tailored to your group.

items.title: Peer Support Groups

items.text: Topics, activities and length can be tailored by request.

items.title: Volunteer Training

items.text: Active listening, confidentiality, inclusive practices and campus resources.

items.title: Navigating Housing

blocks.title: Volunteer Training
body: Learn how to support your friends & classmates! This training adapts Badger Supports’ peer support framework for any student or student group.
Get familiar with campus resources & gain hands-on practice in active listening, confidentiality, inclusive practices, & more.

blocks.title: Navigating Housing in Madison Workshop
body: Get a head start on Madison’s early and fast-paced leasing season. Sessions are tailored to the requesting audience’s needs!

links.label: Learn More on Our Housing Page!

blocks.title: Badger SPILL
body: Badger SPILL is written peer support from Badger Supports. Write what’s on your mind, whenever it’s on your mind, and a trained UW–Madison Student Supporter writes back. It’s confidential.
Badger SPILL does not provide crisis support. If you or a friend are in a crisis, please call 911 or the UHS 24/7 Mental Health Crisis Line: 608-265-5600, option 9.
For written peer support, go directly to Badger SPILL. You do not need to request a program for a group.
